title: Unterspannung beim Start — cranking drags the supply into the window
summary: A tired battery at 12.3 V rests above the undervoltage threshold; 90 A of starter current drops it below, the BCM latches B1001, and the code heals once the alternator carries the load.

dtc.because: at rest, with the key off, 12.3 V is inside the window — nothing is stored yet
cranking holds the supply below 11.5 V for longer than the debounce
a slow crank with working coils is a starter statement, not a misfire: the monitor reads the supply, and 10.9 V is above its floor
the condition is over; the code stays in memory as a healed fault

supply_voltage.because: the terminal voltage under starter load is what the monitor measures

engine_running.because: at 1.5 s of cranking the engine has not caught yet — the code is not a no-start
it does fire on the second second of cranking; the fault is a supply statement

supply_voltage.because: with the alternator carrying the load the cause is gone
